title: DIC Housebound and Aid-and-Attendance Standards by Rate Category
content:
Dependency and Indemnity Compensation (DIC) care-level standards, by rate category. A rate category's care level is basic, housebound or aid and attendance; this page sets, for each category, whether medical evidence is required for aid-and-attendance or housebound status, the basis for housebound status, and how a spouse meeting both standards is paid.

## Category matrix

| Rate category | Medical evidence required for aid-and-attendance or housebound status | Basis for housebound status | Spouse meeting both standards paid only the aid-and-attendance addition |
|---|---|---|---|
| DIC Surviving Spouse (Basic Rate) | No | Permanently housebound by reason of disability | Yes |
| DIC Surviving Spouse (Basic Rate with 8-Year Provision) | No | Permanently housebound by reason of disability | Yes |
| DIC Surviving Spouse (Housebound) | Yes | Permanently housebound by reason of disability | Yes |
| DIC Surviving Spouse (Housebound with 8-Year Provision) | Yes | Permanently housebound by reason of disability | Yes |
| DIC Surviving Spouse (Aid and Attendance) | Yes | Permanently housebound by reason of disability | Yes |
| DIC Surviving Spouse (Aid and Attendance with 8-Year Provision) | Yes | Permanently housebound by reason of disability | Yes |

## Points of judgement

- **Medical evidence.** The medical-evidence requirement is recorded as "No" for the two basic-rate categories and "Yes" for the two housebound and the two aid-and-attendance categories.
- **Housebound basis.** In every category, housebound status rests on the spouse being permanently housebound by reason of disability.
- **Both standards met.** In every category, a surviving spouse who meets both the housebound and the aid-and-attendance standards is paid only the aid-and-attendance addition, not the housebound addition as well.

## Input — judgement — result (hypothetical)

| Input | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Spouse permanently housebound by reason of disability, not needing aid and attendance | Housebound standard met | Housebound status |
| Spouse needing aid and attendance and also permanently housebound | Both standards met | Paid only the aid-and-attendance addition |
